verdict.rationale: There is thin evidence of API and product versioning: the Konnect AI Gateway API is published under a /v1 path, and there is a migration guide from AI Gateway on Kong Gateway 3.x to the AI Gateway 2.x model using a kongctl conversion extension. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, such as timelines, sunset notices or support windows. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit API versioning scheme and compatibility guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: This guide is intended for teams running AI Gateway on Kong Gateway 3.x who want to move to the AI Gateway 2.x control
walks you through migrating an existing configuration using the kongctl AI Gateway conversion extension
